results.label: this tree ships the M110 news-window module (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
a hostile value (a word) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (an array) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (an empty value) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (whitespace) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (zero, below the 1-minute minimum) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (one minute under the floor) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (one minute over the maximum) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (a negative block) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (a fraction) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (a boolean) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
a hostile value (an object) is refused 400 with a documented code, never a 500 and never silently accepted
an exotic numeric spelling is not silently reinterpreted differently from how it is reported: whatever it was read as is what the answer echoes
and every response to the battery was 400 or 200 — no unhandled path, no 500, no stack
the codes actually used are exactly the three documented ones, so a client can switch on them
a hostile settle in the account body (a fraction) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (a boolean) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (an array) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (an object) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (a blank) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (words) is refused on creation
a hostile settle in the account body (null) is refused on creation
and on an update: a hostile settle does not overwrite the stored pair
a stored settle longer than the 30–60 he names is read AS STORED, with a warning, and never repaired to 45 behind the trader’s back
and repeated reads do not drift it: the value is stable across reads, so a warning cannot turn into a rewrite
the engine still reports where that number came from (stored, with the outside-range warning) instead of passing it off as the default
a hand-built row outside the bounds is clamped on read to the shipped limits, with both clamps named — not crashed on and not accepted
a bare number is refused in-process too (as a rejection carrying the code), so no caller can reintroduce the symmetric knob without an error
a missing event instant or a missing clock yields no verdict rather than a verdict at zero offset
a malformed pair yields no verdict at all rather than matching everything
the state gate’s own 60-minute window is exactly where M102 left it: untouched by the news split
a news key smuggled into a gate answer is REFUSED — that surface accepts answers and a revision and nothing else — and the pair is untouched
and the gate’s own accepted path cannot carry a news setting either: answering it leaves both clocks exactly where they were
the risk guardrail beside it still holds: a 5% request is clamped to the course maximum rather than stored, so M110 did not knock out an existing guard
a nonsense symbol is answered without a crash rather than 500
the symbol is case-insensitive, and both spellings see the same release
after the whole battery — refusals, hostile bodies, clamps and reads — not one row of the trader’s data moved anywhere in the database
and inside the account, the only field that moved is the one this probe deliberately set — the widened settle — with the risk request resolved to the guardrail instead of stored
the block side was never touched by any of it, which is the point of two separate clocks
no shipped file lost a guard it had: the settle floor is still enforced by the schema, the route and the module, in that order

scope: M110 hardening: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock and a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser; two asymmetric news clocks, no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
